rule: user_id, age and gender must be present
user_id must be an integer
age must be an integer
age must be within [1, 100]
gender must be one of ['F', 'M']
user_id must be unique (first occurrence kept)
item_id and title must be present
item_id must be an integer
release_date, if present, must be a valid DD-Mon-YYYY date
every genre flag must be 0 or 1
item_id must be unique (first occurrence kept)
user_id, item_id, rating and timestamp must be present
user_id and item_id must be integers
rating must be numeric
rating must be an integer in [1, 5]
timestamp must be a unix epoch integer
timestamp must be between 1995-01-01 and now
exact duplicate interaction rows are not allowed (first kept)
user_id must exist in the validated users table
item_id must exist in the validated items table
